The checked stand-alone verifier is embedded.

value.rationale: For Euclidean repair of measured dissimilarities, the exact coordinatewise perturbation modulus is a natural robustness invariant not equivalent to the repair objective. The sharp change from 4/3 to 8/5 at the first overlapping triangle constraints, a positive equality witness, and persistence under adding points give a meaningful finite cutoff and a structural bound; no unsupported all-n classification is claimed.
